content:
Maya Chen: Heads-up — Capella Systems renewal micro-decision. Procurement requested shorten from 12mo -> 9mo and wants to pay by corporate card. They asked for 10% discount to make up for term change. Onboarding is ~60% done (SSO left + data ingest). Need quick alignment by EOD. @Josh @Nina :thinking:

Josh Patel: can you share ARR and whether Dedicated is in scope for this renewal?

Maya Chen: ARR ~$175k. They're on Hosted API but asked for latency SLA conversation; likely will push Dedicated next quarter. This renewal is for hosted with a plan to upgrade.

Nina Park (CSE): onboarding notes: SSO SAML config pending (we have a stub), data ingest still in staging, enablement workshop scheduled Wed. If we shorten term, we should offer 2 hours free enablement credit to keep timeline.

Samir Khan: legal ping — they want a clause about EU data residency removed unless we add a subprocessor exception. Legal Ops flagged last week. If we accept CC we need to confirm procurement is comfortable with card limits.

Legal Ops: we can do a 9mo amendment. Recommendation: counteroffer 7% discount (not 10%), require PO if total > $100k for any future invoices, and permit CC for first renewal invoice only. Also we will add a narrowly-scoped EU subprocessor exception so onboarding isn't blocked.

Maya Chen: action items: confirm discount level and CC gating. If agreed, Samir to send amendment to procurement, Nina to apply enablement credit, BillingBot to issue quote.

BillingBot: quote created — ID: Q-2026-61357 
Link: https://billing.internal/quotes/Q-2026-61357 
Details: acct=capella term=9mo discount=7% total=153,125 currency=USD

Maya Chen: cool — @Josh, you good with 7% + CC first invoice only and enablement credit? :thumbsup:

Josh Patel: approve 7% and CC-first-invoice-only. We keep PO requirement for >$100k going forward.

Nina Park (CSE): confirmed — I'll add 2 hours enablement credit to the quote and attach onboarding checklist.

Samir Khan: i'll send the amendment to procurement now and include the EU subprocessor line. Will loop in their procurement lead for CC limits.

Legal Ops: drafting amendment, will upload Docusign link once ready. Expect within 4 hours.

Maya Chen: great — locking decision. I'll update renewal tracker and close micro-decision. If anything changes ping this thread. :shipit:
